ui.descriptionLive: Medals on your account are recognized here. Recovery follows the clock and the next milestone; Achievements keeps the history. Curve medals mark educational-model thresholds, not an individual recovery.
ui.descriptionDemo: Soma’s original catalog. Public view: no account medals. The DEMO clock can show the next temporal milestone, but it does not mark a medal as earned.
ui.descriptionLoading: Checking the session to show the progress saved on your account.
ui.descriptionSignedOut: Catalog of {{count}} achievements. Sign in to see earned medals and real progress.
ui.featuredSubtitle: Recent recognitions and the next step. Clock tracking lives in Recovery.
ui.allSubtitle: Each medal recognizes a catalog event: abstinence days or an educational-curve threshold.
ui.temporalSectionSubtitle: They recognize abstinence days. Recovery’s rail follows the same clock; the medal is stored here.
ui.curveSectionSubtitle: They recognize thresholds of a mathematical model. They do not certify your body or your neurotransmitters.
ui.emptyFilter: No catalog achievements match these filters.
ui.error: Your achievements could not be loaded. The public catalog remains available after you sign out.
ui.temporalDetail: Time medal: {{count}} {{unit}} without {{substance}}. Recovery follows this clock; the event is recognized here.
ui.reviewDetail: The catalog stores a {{percent}}% threshold in {{organ}}. There is no recovery curve for this pair, so this card is not presented as a reachable goal.
ui.curveDetail: Educational-curve threshold: {{percent}}% model progress in {{organ}}. It does not certify your health or measure neurotransmitters.
ui.curveProgressDetail: Current progress {{current}}% toward the {{threshold}}% educational threshold. It is the model, not recovered health.
ui.gapMissingRow: This achievement did not arrive in the response, so no percentage is shown.
ui.gapNotTracked: This substance is not on your profile, so there is no progress to calculate.
ui.gapActiveUse: Use is still active. The milestone measures abstinence and has no progress yet.
ui.gapMissingDate: The last-use date is missing, so progress cannot be calculated.
ui.gapInsufficient: There is not enough data to calculate progress.

caffeine-temporal-3.title: Rebooting the Nervous System

caffeine-temporal-7.title: A Week in Power-Save Mode

caffeine-temporal-14.description: Two weeks of a dry build. The compiler no longer asks for coffee.

caffeine-temporal-30.description: A month at stock clock. No overclock, plenty of style.

caffeine-temporal-60.description: Sixty days. Decaf wrote its own trilogy.

caffeine-temporal-90.title: CPU Stable, Coffee Uninstalled
caffeine-temporal-90.description: A season in. CPU stable, coffee uninstalled.

caffeine-temporal-180.description: Six months in native mode. You are the runtime.

alcohol-temporal-1.title: The Last Skyrim Tavern
alcohol-temporal-1.description: First day. The Skyrim tavern closed the shift; the quest did not.

alcohol-temporal-3.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Rum Is Gone

alcohol-temporal-30.title: Thirty Days Away from the Tavern
alcohol-temporal-30.description: A month off the stool. The tavern can wait.

alcohol-temporal-60.description: Sixty days. The witcher left the forbidden potion on the shelf.

alcohol-temporal-90.title: The Brotherhood of the Empty Cup
alcohol-temporal-90.description: A season in. The empty-cup fellowship toasts with water and nerve.

alcohol-temporal-180.title: Half a Year Sailing Without Rum
alcohol-temporal-180.description: Six months sailing without rum. The sea still makes the logbook.

alcohol-temporal-365.title: Lord of the Seven Sober Kingdoms
alcohol-temporal-365.description: A year. The seven kingdoms fit in a day; the throne is showing up tomorrow.
